title: Quick tasks
sub: Run tasks with one button – Hostwerk asks first. ☆ pins them to the top.
search: Search tasks – Enter runs the first one
noMatchHint: Try another word – the search looks at name, action and target.
stillRunning: “{name}” is still running – the result shows up here once it is done.
emptyHint: Create one in Hostwerk under “Tasks” – e.g. a backup or a report.
taskGone: This task no longer exists – it was deleted in Hostwerk.
